verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Secureframe shipping its own MCP server (exposing Secureframe's data/tools to external AI clients), not Secureframe acting as an MCP client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. Since Secureframe is a SaaS compliance platform (not an agent), this client-side axis is applicable but no evidence shows it can plug in and use tools from other MCP servers.
